_about: THE RETINUE (RETINUE, rule 425(c), ask line 206; Paolo 10/26: 'do research on all the people in Battle Brothers who can join your camp and what they do to help you'). Battle Brothers' eighteen followers (the wiki's Retinue page and each follower's page, records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_ALL_EIGHTEEN_FOLLOWERS_TAPE_THAT_KEEPS_A_RUN_ALIVE_AND_THE_ARMOUR_SHOWS_10_26_26.md), each a real person of the dead Las Vegas in our own skin. A modder edits a row and reloads: engine/bohemia_camp.js reads this file at load (its copy below is the same numbers, held equal by gates/the_retinue_gate.js). Bought once, never a wage (rule 56). Slots by CLOUT (renown.json). Words are attempts, draft:true; WORDS may better them; numbers are TUNING's (the one table, section V).

met_per_place.source: ours: three of the eighteen are in a town's hall each week, dealt by the town's name and the week (Battle Brothers' posts change the same way); draft, TUNING

value.id: the follower's key (never change it on a shipped row: saves keep it)
value.name: who he is
value.was: who he was before the dollar died, one line
value.look: a person of the valley (engine/bohemia_people_mix.js): his face and his body, the same id on every screen
value.does: his one effect, in plain words
value.nums: the numbers the game reads (BohemiaCamp.mult for a multiplier, BohemiaCamp.plus for a count)
value.ask: what he says when you meet him in a town's hall
value.joins: what is heard when he joins
value.reads: where the game does his work (null when nothing does it yet)
value.shut: why his hire is shut (null when he works); nobody pays for help that never comes

followers.source: Battle Brothers wiki, Retinue and the eighteen follower pages (bb_all/1940 to 1975, the coordinator's copy); prices the wiki's crowns at ten to one through TUNING (rule 264's pace); GROK_121 PASSED FILTER for the six

value.name: Graciela Ochoa
value.was: Ran the night line at a Fremont Street buffet for twenty-two years. She can feed forty off one burn barrel.
value.does: The crew eats for less, and a hurt man gets a hitpoint more back every hour.
value.ask: I fed the whole Strip once. I can feed your crew on half of what you are wasting.
value.joins: Graciela puts her pot on your fire.
value.reads: engine/bohemia_condition.js (the hour's healing) and the nightly bill (the food)

value.name: Danny Nguyen
value.was: Drove a cab nineteen years. He still knows every back way across the valley, and which ones flood.
value.does: The roads go by quicker: a block on the map costs 15% less time.
value.ask: Nineteen years in a cab. I know the way around everything that is blocking you.
value.joins: Danny rides up front now. The roads go by quicker.
value.reads: the map's travel time a block (BohemiaCamp.mult('travel'))

value.name: Earl Pruitt
value.was: Sat in a casino's eye in the sky, forty screens at once. Some nights the dark ones still show him something.
value.does: Sees one block further down a street, a quarter further over open ground, and a camp is warned two blocks sooner.
value.ask: I watched forty screens a shift. I will see them coming before you hear them.
value.joins: Earl takes the high spot. Nothing gets close without him saying so.
value.reads: the map's sight and the camp's warning (BohemiaCamp.plus('street'), mult('open'), plus('warn'))

value.name: Hector Salas
value.was: Counted the cage at a downtown casino. He can weigh a brick of bills in his hand and tell you if it is short.
value.does: The hired men take 15% less pay a night, and every other follower costs 15% less.
value.ask: Every battery you spend, I count twice. You will pay less for everybody.
value.joins: Hector opens his ledger. Everybody costs a little less now.
value.reads: engine/bohemia_wages.js (the night's pay) and this file's prices

value.name: Walt Hensley
value.was: Ran a body shop on Boulder Highway. Now he welds car doors into armour.
value.does: Armour gets mended a fifth quicker, and it eats a fifth less tape.
value.ask: Bring me a car door and an hour. I will make it stop a bullet.
value.joins: Walt sets up by the cart. The armour gets mended quicker.

value.name: Alan Cho
value.was: An ER doctor at the county hospital until the power went. He still washes his hands before he cuts.
value.does: A man struck down heals his fresh wound a day sooner.
value.ask: I worked the ER the night the lights went out. Nothing your men bring me will scare me.
value.joins: Doc Cho lays out what is left of his kit.

value.name: Ines Baptiste
value.was: Ran a temp agency's phone bank. She still knows every board in the valley.
value.does: Every town's jobs and what is going on there, from anywhere on the map.
value.ask: I placed half this valley in jobs once. I still know who is hiring, everywhere.
value.joins: Ines is with you. She knows every board in the valley.
value.shut: RUN TWO and UI TWO: the town card and the phone read BohemiaCamp.has('agent')

value.name: Felix Amari
value.was: A pharmacist at an all-night drugstore on the Strip. Now he cooks down what the lab beasts leave behind.
value.does: A quarter of the time, what he makes costs none of its parts.
value.ask: Bring me what is left of those things from the lab. I can make something out of it.
value.joins: Felix is with you. He wants the next beast's body.
value.shut: nobody yet: the game has no crafting

value.name: Marcus Bell
value.was: A skip tracer for a downtown bail bondsman. He still carries the bills, and the faces on them.
value.does: More of the hard ones turn up, and he pays 30 to 75 batteries a head for them.
value.ask: Some of the people out there still have a price on them. I know which ones.
value.joins: Marcus is with you. He keeps the bills in his coat.
value.shut: WORLD and COMBAT: ours.outclass reads plus('champions'), the spoils pay the head

value.name: Rusty Kogan
value.was: Sold what he heard on a police scanner. The scanner still talks, and some nights nobody is left to be talking.
value.does: Some caravans stay on your map wherever they go.
value.ask: I hear where the trucks go. I will tell you before anybody else does.
value.joins: Rusty is with you. His scanner hisses all night.
value.shut: RUN: the map draws has('brigand') caravans out of sight

value.name: Ken Takeda
value.was: A transit planner. He carries the dead city's bus maps in a tube and marks what is still there.
value.does: He pays you 10 to 40 batteries for every place you find on your own.
value.ask: Every place you find that is not on my maps, I will pay you for it.
value.joins: Ken is with you. He unrolls a bus map on the fire's crate.
value.shut: RUN: the map that fills in (rule 243) pays has('cartographer')

value.name: Darnell Price
value.was: A high-school football coach. He never stopped blowing the whistle.
value.does: New men learn a fifth faster, two in a hundred less each level after.
value.ask: Give me your new guys. Two weeks and they will learn faster than you ever did.
value.joins: Coach Price is with you. The whistle goes at dawn.

value.name: Chuy Morales
value.was: A wedding DJ with one speaker left. He plays your fights back to every town you walk into.
value.does: Everything you do gets talked about: your name grows 15 percent faster.
value.ask: One speaker, one battery, and the whole valley knows your name.
value.joins: Chuy is with you. The speaker crackles on.

value.name: Gary Lund
value.was: Sold cars on Boulder Highway for twenty years. He can make a grudge sound like a deal.
value.does: A town's good word for you fades slower, and a grudge mends faster.
value.ask: Nobody stays mad at you if I am the one talking. Twenty years selling cars.
value.joins: Gary is with you. He shakes every hand in town.
value.reads: the town's relations at dawn (slices/BOHEMIA_SETTLEMENT_SCREEN.html relDawn, engine/bohemia_relations.js dawn)

value.name: Tony Arce
value.was: A warehouse night manager. Everything has a shelf, and he knows what is on every one.
value.does: Room for 50 more tape, 50 more meds and 100 more rounds.
value.ask: Your stuff is everywhere. Give me a cart and a marker and you will carry more.
value.joins: Tony is with you. Everything gets a shelf.
value.shut: ECONOMY: the counts get their caps and read plus('tapeRoom')

value.name: Yolanda Reyes
value.was: A casino floor manager on the Strip. She hired thousands and fired more.
value.does: Men cost a tenth less to hire, and two to four more stand at every post.
value.ask: I hired thousands. I will find you better men and get them cheaper.
value.joins: Yolanda is with you. Every post has more men now.

value.name: Dot Kowalski
value.was: Walks the field after a fight, a shopping bag in each hand, and does not look at the faces.
value.does: After a fight she brings back tape off the broken armour and some of the rounds you fired.
value.ask: After you are done, I go through what is left. You would be surprised what comes back.
value.joins: Dot is with you. She brings her bags.
value.reads: the end screen (slices/BOHEMIA_SPOILS_SCREEN.html open): the tape; the rounds wait on the fight counting rounds fired

value.name: Memo Gallardo
value.was: The swap meet's king. He knows who makes what, and who will pay for it.
value.does: One more trade good for sale wherever it is made.
value.ask: I know every stall in the valley. I will find you goods worth carrying.
value.joins: Memo is with you. He already has a buyer in mind.
value.shut: ECONOMY: the trade goods read plus('tradeGoods')
